verdict.rationale: Cursor's own docs say developers can choose between models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, SpaceXAI and Cursor. Per-session selection is concrete in the CLI (`--model gpt-5`), the Cloud Agents API (`model.id` from GET /v1/models) and custom subagents. Bring-your-own keys extend this to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure OpenAI and Bedrock, though only for chat models, not Tab completion. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of in-IDE model switching across providers, and model choice for Tab completion (BYO keys are limited to chat).

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: Choose between every cutting-edge model from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, SpaceXAI, and Cursor.
You can add your own API keys so Cursor uses your preferred AI models. This lets you send unlimited AI messages at your own cost through providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google.
runs `agent -p "Your prompt here" --model gpt-5` under a `CURSOR_API_KEY` repository secret
